We drive the all-new electric Mercedes-Benz GLC, built on a dedicated EV platform, ahead of its India launch. It promises a 715km range, 330kW charging and a cabin dominated by a 39-inch Hyperscreen.
The GLC EV is easy to spot. Its large upright grille takes inspiration from the W112 S-Class and carries 942 lighting elements, with an illuminated three-pointed star in the middle. Flush door handles extend when you unlock the car, and a black band links the LED tail-lamps at the back.
